rule: docs/TREE_PLAN.md: palms only - spaced palms on the promenade and the median (zone 105 -> about 95)
written: by hand, 19 Nov 2026 (cloud session, the city-wide superchecker run from the bottom of the list). The block's thirteen builder trees go (five broadleaf: corals and magnolias; eight palms); three palms come back on their own spots. The palms 0.6 and 1.2 m from walls and fences stay out.

trees.why: the grass in front of the inn, the bakery and the grill on the car park side, by the agaves and the iceplant: the line's west palm
the same grass line 32 m east: two spaced palms frame the shopfronts seen from the car park, as on the next block east
the back lawn behind the shops, by the white adirondack where the staff sit: one tall fan palm with light shade
